en: Black‑and‑white view of an inner courtyard of an old European building with timber eaves and a continuous wooden balcony running along the upper floor. The courtyard has stone plaques and reliefs on the walls, barred basement windows, and a large arched portal with an iron gate reached by a short exterior stair. Above the ground-floor windows is a framed inscription panel in a Gothic or Fraktur script, and various coats of arms or carved shields decorate the walls. In one corner lies a pile of round stone cannonballs, suggesting a historic or fortified site. The architecture has a late‑medieval / early‑Renaissance Central European character.
